record.original_question: Let (Omega, mu) be a sigma-finite measure space, let V be a dense subspace of L2(Omega), let a: V x V -> C be a closed sectorial sesquilinear form, let -A generate the associated bounded analytic semigroup (T(t)) on L2(Omega), and suppose there exists a function g in L-infinity(Omega) with g > 0 mu-almost everywhere and 1/g in L-infinity(Omega) such that ||g T(t)f||_infinity <= ||g f||_infinity for all f in L2(Omega) intersect L-infinity(Omega) and all t >= 0. How can one find or explicitly construct such a weight g?

evidence.quote: It is clear that (T (t))t≥0 is L∞ -bounded if there exists a function g ∈ L∞ (Ω) with g > 0 µ-a.e. and 1/g ∈ L∞ (Ω) satisfying kgT (t)f k∞ ≤ kgf k∞ for all f ∈ L∞ (Ω) ∩ L2 (Ω).

Problem 24 (Weight construction for L∞ -contraction). In the setting of Problem 21, assume that a function g ∈ L∞ (Ω) satisfying g > 0 µ-a.e., 1/g ∈ L∞ (Ω), and (3) exists. How can we find or construct such a function g?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a $\sigma$-finite measure space and let $V$ be a dense linear subspace of $L^2(\Omega)$. Let $a:V	imes V	o\mathbb{C}$ be a densely defined, closed, sectorial sesquilinear form, and let $-A$ be the associated operator on $L^2(\Omega)$, so that $A$ generates a bounded analytic semigroup $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ on $L^2(\Omega)$.

Suppose that there exists a measurable function $g:\Omega	o(0,\infty)$ with $g\in L^\infty(\Omega)$ and $1/g\in L^\infty(\Omega)$ such that the weighted contraction estimate
$$\|g\, T(t) f\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)} \;\le\; \|g\, f\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)}\qquad	ext{for all }f\in L^2(\Omega)\cap L^\infty(\Omega)	ext{ and all }t\ge 0$$
holds. Note that this condition implies in particular that $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ extends to a bounded semigroup on $L^\infty(\Omega)$.

Problem: Devise a general method, given the form $a$ (or equivalently the generator $-A$), to find or explicitly construct such a weight $g$. In particular, characterize $g$ (or the class of admissible $g$) in terms of the form $a$, the domain of $A$, or the resolvent of $A$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in a recent collection of open problems on functional analysis / semigroup theory; no published construction or characterization of such a weight in the stated generality appears to be known.
